source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 31 (PDF 217-231), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 31 (Materials and Energy) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 According to the chapter, the most ancient materials used by humans include:
(Chapter ke mutabiq insaan ke sab se purane materials mein kya shamil hai?)

options.text: lakri, metals aur janwaron se hasil materials

blocks.explanation: Sab se purane materials lakri, metals aur janwaron se hasil hone wali cheezen (jaise kapre) hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: The most ancient materials are wood, metals, and those obtained from animals

blocks.prompt:
2 The small but efficient energy device found in a mobile phone (Figure 31.1) is a:
(Mobile phone mein mojood chhota magar efficient energy device (Figure 31.1) kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Figure 31.1: mobile mein metals, plastic, un ke composites aur chhoti magar efficient Li-ion battery hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: a small but efficient energy device, i.e., Li-ion battery

blocks.prompt:
3 Materials are understood by their:
(Materials ko kin cheezon se samjha jata hai?)

options.text: composition, chemical bonds ki nature aur microstructure

blocks.explanation: Materials ko un ki composition (banawat), chemical bonds ki nature aur microstructure se samjha jata hai (31.1).

book_ref.quote: They are understood by their composition, the nature of chemical bonds, and the microstructure.

blocks.prompt:
4 Hardness and elasticity are examples of which properties of a material?
(Hardness aur elasticity material ki kis qisam ki properties ki misaal hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter mein mechanical properties ki misaal hardness aur elasticity di gayi hai (31.1).

book_ref.quote: mechanical (e.g., hardness, elasticity, etc.)

blocks.prompt:
5 Metals can be easily rolled into sheets and drawn into wires without fracture because they are:
(Metals ko asaani se chadaron mein aur taaron mein dhaala ja sakta hai kyun ke woh:)
blocks.explanation: Metals malleable (chadar banne wale) aur ductile (taar banne wale) hain, is liye toote baghair chadar ya taar ban jate hain (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: They are malleable and ductile and thus can be easily rolled into sheets

blocks.prompt:
6 Aluminium is used in the bodies of aircraft mainly because it is:
(Aluminium aircraft ki body mein zyada tar kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aluminium halka (light-weight) hai is liye aircraft ki body mein istemal hota hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Aluminum is utilized in the bodies of aircrafts, because it is light-weight

blocks.prompt:
7 Which metal is normally used in electric wires because of its excellent conductivity?
(Kaun si metal behtareen conductivity ki wajah se electric wires mein istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Copper ki conductivity behtareen hai is liye electric wires mein istemal hota hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: copper is normally used into electric wires since it has amazing conductivity

blocks.prompt:
8 Which pair of metals can be found in the free (metallic) state in nature?
(Kaun se do metals fitrat mein free (metallic) state mein mil sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kam reactive metals jaise gold aur platinum free state mein milte hain; zyada reactive metals ores ki shakal mein (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Less reactive metals, such as gold and platinum can be found in the free state

blocks.prompt:
9 Haematite, an ore of iron, has the formula:
(Iron ki ore haematite ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter ke mutabiq haematite Fe₂O₃ hai jo iron ki ore hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: hematite (Fe₂O₃) is an ore of iron

blocks.prompt:
10 The earthly materials and impurities mixed with the desired metal compound in an ore are called:
(Ore mein matloob metal compound ke saath mili mitti aur impurities ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ore matloob metal compound, impurities aur mitti wale materials ka mixture hai; inhen gangue kehte hain (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: earthly materials, which are called gangue

blocks.prompt:
11 The science of extracting metals out of their ores and making them pure for better use is called:
(Metals ko un ki ores se nikalne aur behtar istemal ke liye khalis karne ki science ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Metallurgy metals ko ores se nikalne aur khalis karne ki science hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Metallurgy is the science of extracting metals out of their ores

blocks.prompt:
12 The procedure used to extract a metal is decided mainly by:
(Metal nikalne ka tareeqa zyada tar kis cheez se tay hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Metal ki reactivity aur nature nikalne ka tareeqa tay karti hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The reactivity and the nature of the metal defines the extraction procedure.

blocks.prompt:
13 The step in which the ore is made free from impurities as much as possible is:
(Woh step jis mein ore ko jitna ho sake impurities se paak kiya jata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Ore concentration mein ore ko jitna mumkin ho impurities se paak kiya jata hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Ore Concentration is the process in which the ore of a metal is made free from impurities

blocks.prompt:
14 Roasting involves heating:
(Roasting mein kya garam kiya jata hai?)

options.text: sulphide ore ko zyada hawa mein
carbonate ore ko baghair hawa ke
metal oxide ko carbon ke saath
pighle compound ko electric current ke saath

blocks.explanation: Roasting mein sulphide ore ko zyada hawa mein garam kiya jata hai, misaal 2ZnS + 3O₂ → 2ZnO + 2SO₂ (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: heating a sulphide ore of a metal with excess supply of air

blocks.prompt:
15 Calcination is the heating of:
(Calcination kis cheez ko garam karna hai?)

options.text: sulphide ore ko zyada hawa mein
metal carbonate ore ko kam ya baghair hawa ke

blocks.explanation: Calcination mein metal carbonate ore ko kam ya baghair hawa ke garam karke oxide banaya jata hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: a metal carbonate ore is heated in a limited or no air environment

blocks.prompt:
16 Using 2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g), the number of moles of O₂ needed to roast 6 mol of ZnS is:
(2ZnS(s) + 3O₂(g) → 2ZnO(s) + 2SO₂(g) ke mutabiq 6 mol ZnS ko roast karne ke liye O₂ ke kitne moles chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: 2 mol ZnS ko 3 mol O₂ chahiye, to 6 mol ZnS ko 6 × 3/2 = 9 mol O₂ (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This can be done in two ways, mostly.

blocks.prompt:
17 250 g of ZnCO₃ (molar mass 125 g mol⁻¹) is calcined: ZnCO₃(s) → ZnO(s) + CO₂(g). The mass of CO₂ (molar mass 44 g mol⁻¹) given off is:
(250 g ZnCO₃ (molar mass 125 g mol⁻¹) ko calcine kiya jata hai: ZnCO₃(s) → ZnO(s) + CO₂(g). Kitne gram CO₂ (molar mass 44 g mol⁻¹) niklegi?)
blocks.explanation: ZnCO₃ ke moles = 250/125 = 2 mol; 1:1 ratio se 2 mol CO₂ = 2 × 44 = 88 g (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Another method is calcination in which a metal carbonate ore is heated

blocks.prompt:
18 The most important step of metal extraction is:
(Metal nikalne ka sab se ahem step kaun sa hai?)

options.text: metal oxides ki metal mein reduction

blocks.explanation: Metal oxides ki reduction metal nikalne ka sab se ahem step hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The reduction of metal oxides is the most important step of metal extraction.

blocks.prompt:
19 Carbon is used as the reducing agent for metals that are:
(Carbon kin metals ke liye reducing agent ke taur par istemal hota hai?)

options.text: reactivity series mein carbon se ooper
sirf free state mein milne wali
reactivity series mein carbon se neeche

blocks.explanation: Kam reactive metals (reactivity series mein carbon se neeche) ke liye carbon reducing agent hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: For less reactive metals (below carbon in the reactivity series), carbon is used as a reducing agent.

blocks.prompt:
20 In the reduction of iron ore, the species that actually removes oxygen from Fe₂O₃ is:
(Iron ore ki reduction mein Fe₂O₃ se oxygen asal mein kaun nikalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon pehle CO banta hai, phir CO oxygen nikalti hai: Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂ (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: Carbon monoxide displaces the oxygen from the metal oxide to form a free metal.

blocks.prompt:
21 Using Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂, the mass of iron obtained from 320 kg of Fe₂O₃ (molar mass 160 g mol⁻¹; Fe = 56 g mol⁻¹) is:
(Fe₂O₃ + 3CO → 2Fe + 3CO₂ ke mutabiq 320 kg Fe₂O₃ (molar mass 160 g mol⁻¹; Fe = 56 g mol⁻¹) se kitna iron milega?)

book_ref.quote: An example is the reduction of the iron ore as follows:

blocks.prompt:
22 In the electrolytic extraction of a metal, the metal is formed at the:
(Electrolytic tareeqe se metal nikalte waqt metal kahan banti hai?)

options.text: anode par, jahan metal ions electrons chhorte hain
cathode par, jahan positive metal ions electrons lete hain
cathode par, jahan negative ions electrons chhorte hain
anode par, jahan oxygen electrons leti hai

blocks.explanation: Positive metal ions negative electrode (cathode) ki taraf jate hain aur electrons le kar metal bante hain (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: The positive metal ions move to the negative electrode (cathode)

blocks.prompt:
23 Which group of metals is extracted by the electrolytic method because carbon cannot reduce their oxides?
(Kin metals ko electrolytic tareeqe se nikala jata hai kyun ke carbon un ke oxides ko reduce nahi kar sakta?)
blocks.explanation: Electrolytic tareeqa bohat reactive metals jaise Na, K aur Al ke liye zaroori hai jo carbon se reduce nahi hote (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This method is crucial for extracting highly reactive metals

blocks.prompt:
24 Copper used in electrical wiring should be 99.99% pure. The mass of impurity allowed in 2.0 kg of such copper is:
(Electrical wiring ka copper 99.99% khalis hona chahiye. Aise 2.0 kg copper mein impurity ki kitni miqdaar ho sakti hai?)

book_ref.quote: copper needs to be 99.99% pure in the electrical wiring

blocks.prompt:
25 Which of the following is NOT named in the chapter as a method of refining a metal?
(In mein se kaun sa tareeqa chapter mein metal refine karne ke liye nahi bataya gaya?)
blocks.explanation: Metal ko thermal, chemical ya electrochemical tareeqon se refine kiya jata hai; roasting sulphide ore ko oxide banati hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: A metal can be refined by thermal, chemical or electrochemical methods.

blocks.prompt:
26 Alloying is done mainly to:
(Alloying zyada tar kis liye ki jati hai?)

options.text: microstructure badal kar properties behtar karna

blocks.explanation: Alloying metal ka microstructure badal kar strength aur corrosion resistance jaisi properties behtar karti hai (31.1.1).

book_ref.quote: This is done to alter the microstructure of the metal to enhance the properties

blocks.prompt:
27 Brass is an alloy of:
(Brass kin elements ka alloy hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.1: brass = copper (60-90%) + zinc (10-40%), electrical fittings mein istemal.

blocks.prompt:
28 Medals and statues are commonly made of:
(Medals aur statues aam taur par kis alloy se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.1: bronze (copper 88% + tin 12%) sakht aur ghisne se mehfooz hai; medals aur statues mein istemal.

book_ref.quote: Common alloys and their uses are provided in Table 31.1.

blocks.prompt:
29 Bronze contains 88% copper and 12% tin. The mass of tin in a 350 g bronze statue is:
(Bronze mein 88% copper aur 12% tin hota hai. 350 g bronze ke statue mein tin kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Table 31.1 Properties and uses of common alloys

blocks.prompt:
30 The lightweight, strong, corrosion-resistant alloy used for aircraft bodies is:
(Halka, mazboot aur corrosion se mehfooz alloy jo aircraft ki body mein istemal hota hai:)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.1: duralumin (zyada aluminium, saath Cu, Mg, Mn) halka, mazboot aur corrosion resistant hai; aircraft body mein.

book_ref.quote: Aluminium (93-95%) + Copper (3.5-4.5%) + Magnesium (0.4-0.7%) + Manganese (0.4-0.7%)

blocks.prompt:
31 According to Table 31.1, the carbon content of steel is about:
(Table 31.1 ke mutabiq steel mein carbon kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Steel = iron (98-99%) + carbon (0.1-2%) aur doosre elements jaise Cr, Ni, Mn (Table 31.1).

book_ref.quote: Iron (98-99%) + Carbon (0.1-2%) (and other elements: Cr, Ni, Mn, Si, S)

blocks.prompt:
32 Ceramics are best described as:
(Ceramics ko behtareen taur par kaise bayan kiya jata hai?)

options.text: sakht magar brittle, zyada melting point aur achhi insulation
halke semiconductors jo voltage se mutasir hon

blocks.explanation: Ceramics sakht magar bhurbhure (brittle) hain, un ka melting point zyada aur insulation behtareen hai (31.1.2).

book_ref.quote: Ceramics are hard but brittle materials that have high melting temperatures

blocks.prompt:
33 Chemically, ceramics contain a blend of:
(Kemiyai taur par ceramics mein kya mila hota hai?)

options.text: alkali, alkaline earth metals aur aluminium ke silicates aur oxides

blocks.explanation: Ceramics mein alkali, alkaline earth metals aur aluminium ke silicates aur oxides hote hain, jaise K₂O, Na₂O, CaO, Al₂SiO₅ (31.1.2).

book_ref.quote: such as K₂O, Na₂O, CaO, Al₂SiO₅, etc.

blocks.prompt:
34 Which ceramic is named for making spark plugs?
(Spark plugs banane ke liye kaun sa ceramic bataya gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ceramic istemal: porcelain sanitary ware, glass windows aur optical fibres, alumina spark plugs (31.1.2).

book_ref.quote: windows and optical fibres (glass), spark plugs (alumina), etc.

blocks.prompt:
35 Which application example is given in Table 31.2 for the high melting point of ceramics?
(Table 31.2 mein ceramics ke zyada melting point ki kaun si misaal di gayi hai?)

options.text: steel furnaces ki lining ki refractory bricks

blocks.explanation: Table 31.2: zyada melting point – steel furnaces ki lining ki refractory bricks.

book_ref.quote: Refractory bricks lining steel furnaces.

blocks.prompt:
36 Silicon carbide is used in sandpaper because of which property of ceramics?
(Silicon carbide sandpaper mein ceramics ki kis property ki wajah se istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.2: hardness aur wear resistance – abrasives jaise sandpaper mein silicon carbide, aur cutting tools.

book_ref.quote: Abrasives (e.g., silicon carbide in sandpaper) and cutting tools.

blocks.prompt:
37 Porcelain is used on power lines because ceramics are:
(Power lines par porcelain kyun lagaya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.2: aksar ceramics bijli nahi guzarte – power lines par porcelain insulators.

book_ref.quote: Porcelain insulators on power lines.

blocks.prompt:
38 Ceramic coatings are applied on chemical processing equipment because ceramics show:
(Chemical processing equipment par ceramic coating kyun ki jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 31.2: chemical inertness – corrosion aur chemical hamle se bohat mehfooz.

book_ref.quote: Ceramic coatings on chemical processing equipment.

blocks.prompt:
39 Which statement about polymers is given in the chapter?
(Polymers ke baare mein chapter mein kaun sa bayan diya gaya hai?)

options.text: Inorganic polymers organic se zyada aam hain
Organic polymers zyada aam hain magar kuch applications mein inorganic polymers zyada ahem hain

blocks.explanation: Polymers bare inorganic ya organic molecules hain; organic zyada aam hain, inorganic kuch applications mein zyada ahem (31.1.3).

book_ref.quote: Although, organic polymers are much more common

blocks.prompt:
40 In a composite, the components caged inside the matrix are called:
(Composite mein matrix ke andar band components ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aik component matrix hai; matrix ke andar band baqi components reinforcement agents hain (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: One component is called the matrix, while the others, which are caged in the matrix

blocks.prompt:
41 In a composite, high strength is provided mainly by the:
(Composite mein zyada strength zyada tar kaun deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Matrix reinforcement ko pakarta hai, jab ke reinforcement material ko zyada strength deta hai (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: whereas the reinforcement provides high strength to the material

blocks.prompt:
42 In fibreglass, the matrix is made of:
(Fibreglass mein matrix kis cheez ka bana hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fibreglass mein matrix polymer hai; reinforcement fabric, glass ya carbon wale fibres ho sakte hain (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: An example is fibreglass, which is composed of a polymer as the matrix

blocks.prompt:
43 Carbon fibre is widely used in the aircraft and sports gear industry because of its:
(Carbon fibre aircraft aur sports gear industry mein kyun istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon fibre halka aur bohat paedaar hai is liye aircraft aur sports gear mein istemal hota hai (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: carbon fibre is widely used in the aircraft and sports gear industry

blocks.prompt:
44 Boat hulls and car bodies are commonly made of:
(Kashti ke dhanche (boat hulls) aur car bodies aam taur par kis se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Boat hulls aur car bodies fibreglass se bante hain (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: boat hulls and car bodies are made of fibreglass

blocks.prompt:
45 Composites are suitable for demanding applications because they possess:
(Composites mushkil applications ke liye kyun munasib hain?)

options.text: achha strength-to-weight ratio aur mazboot corrosion resistance

blocks.explanation: Composites ka strength-to-weight ratio achha aur corrosion resistance mazboot hota hai (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: Composites possess good strength to weight ratio and strong resistance to corrosion

blocks.prompt:
46 According to Figure 31.3, fibreglass is used for:
(Figure 31.3 ke mutabiq fibreglass kis kaam aata hai?)

options.text: deewaron aur chhat ko garmi sardi se insulate karna

blocks.explanation: Figure 31.3: fibreglass deewaron aur chhat ko garmi sardi se insulate karne ke liye (31.1.4).

book_ref.quote: Fibreglass is used for insulating walls and ceiling from heat and cold

blocks.prompt:
47 Semiconductors conduct electricity only in special conditions and are sensitive to:
(Semiconductors sirf khaas halaat mein bijli guzarte hain aur kis se mutasir hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Semiconductors sirf khaas halaat mein conduct karte hain aur roshni, heat aur voltage se mutasir hote hain (31.1.5).

book_ref.quote: are light, heat, and voltage sensitive

blocks.prompt:
48 The difference between conductors and semiconductors stated in the chapter is that in a semiconductor:
(Chapter ke mutabiq conductors aur semiconductors mein farq yeh hai ke semiconductor mein:)

options.text: current ko zaroorat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai
current hamesha metals se zyada hota hai
current sirf absolute zero par behta hai

blocks.explanation: Semiconductor mein current ko zaroorat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai (31.1.5).

book_ref.quote: the current passing through a semiconductor can be controlled as demanded

blocks.prompt:
49 The most common semiconductor, used in microchips and solar panels, is:
(Sab se aam semiconductor jo microchips aur solar panels mein istemal hota hai:)
blocks.explanation: Silicon sab se aam semiconductor hai; effective aur waafir hone ki wajah se microchips aur solar panels mein (31.1.5).

book_ref.quote: The most common semiconductor is silicon, which is used in microchips and solar panels

blocks.prompt:
50 Gallium arsenide (GaAs) is used in:
(Gallium arsenide (GaAs) kahan istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: GaAs wireless communication jaise 5G internet devices mein istemal hota hai (31.1.5).

book_ref.quote: Another major semiconductor is gallium arsenide (GaAs)

blocks.prompt:
51 Which semiconductor is used in electric cars for fast charging?
(Electric cars mein fast charging ke liye kaun sa semiconductor istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gallium nitride (GaN) electric cars mein fast charging ke liye istemal hota hai (31.1.5).

book_ref.quote: Gallium nitride (GaN) is used in electric cars for fast charging

blocks.prompt:
52 A mobile SIM card consists of:
(Mobile SIM card kis cheez se bana hota hai?)

options.text: silicon chip aur chhote parts jaise copper connectors

blocks.explanation: Mobile SIM card silicon chip aur kuch chhote parts jaise copper connectors se bana hai (31.1.5).

book_ref.quote: A mobile SIM card is composed of a silicon chip

blocks.prompt:
53 The extent to which a substance can harm an organism or the environment is called its:
(Kisi substance ka jaandaar ya mahol ko nuqsan pohanchane ki had kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Toxicity (zehreela-pan) woh had hai jis tak substance jaandaar ya mahol ko nuqsan de sakta hai (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Toxicity is the extent to which a substance can harm an organism or the environment.

blocks.prompt:
54 A material may be toxic during:
(Material kab zehreela ho sakta hai?)

options.text: tayyari, istemal aur aakhri disposal ke dauraan

blocks.explanation: Material apni tayyari, istemal aur aakhri disposal ke dauraan zehreela ho sakta hai (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: A material may be toxic during its production, use, and final disposal.

blocks.prompt:
55 Substances that change DNA and genes are called:
(DNA aur genes ko badalne wale substances ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chromium ko carcinogen (cancer paida karne wala) aur mutagen (DNA aur genes badalne wala) bataya gaya hai (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: mutagens (change DNA and genes)

blocks.prompt:
56 Which metal is given as an example of a carcinogen and mutagen that also causes respiratory issues?
(Kaun si metal carcinogen aur mutagen ki misaal hai jo saans ke masail bhi paida karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chromium jaisi metals carcinogen, mutagen hain aur saans ke masail deti hain – health hazard (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: metals like chromium are carcinogens (cause cancer)

blocks.prompt:
57 A flammable or explosive material that can damage a building is an example of a:
(Aag pakarne wala ya dhamaka-khez material jo building ko nuqsan de, kis hazard ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch materials apni properties ki wajah se physical hazard dete hain, jaise flammable ya explosive materials (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: For example, a flammable or an explosive material can harm humans

blocks.prompt:
58 Heavy metals that leach into soil and groundwater and harm aquatic life cause:
(Heavy metals jo mitti aur zameeni paani mein riss kar aabi zindagi ko nuqsan dein, kya paida karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Environmental hazards aabi zindagi aur mahol ko lambe arse ka nuqsan dete hain; lead, mercury, cadmium mitti aur paani mein riss jati hain (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: Heavy metals like lead, mercury, and cadmium can leach into soil and groundwater.

blocks.prompt:
59 Some additives in plastics can cause:
(Plastics mein kuch additives kya paida kar sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Plastics ke kuch additives jism mein hormonal masail paida kar sakte hain – health hazard (31.2.1).

book_ref.quote: some additives in plastics, which can cause hormonal problems in the body

blocks.prompt:
60 Lead, mercury and cadmium are commonly found in:
(Lead, mercury aur cadmium aam taur par kahan milte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pb, Hg aur Cd electronics, batteries aur fluorescent lights mein milte hain; zameeni paani tak pohanch sakte hain (31.2.2).

book_ref.quote: are the common metals found in electronics, batteries, and fluorescent lights

blocks.prompt:
61 Phthalates and bisphenol A (BPA) are toxic additives in plastics that can:
(Phthalates aur bisphenol A (BPA) plastics ke zehreele additives hain jo:)

options.text: hormones mein khalal daal sakte hain

blocks.explanation: Bohat se plastics mein phthalates ya BPA jaise zehreele additives hote hain jo hormones mein khalal daalte hain (31.2.2).

book_ref.quote: toxic additives such as phthalates or bisphenol A (BPA)

blocks.prompt:
62 According to the chapter, microplastics can now be found in:
(Chapter ke mutabiq microplastics ab kahan paye jate hain?)

options.text: samandar, mitti balke khane mein bhi

blocks.explanation: Microplastics ab samandar, mitti balke khane mein bhi milte hain aur insaan aur ecosystem par lamba asar rakhte hain (31.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Microplastics can now be found in oceans, soil, and even in food

blocks.prompt:
63 The two major toxic materials discussed as examples in the chapter are:
(Chapter mein misaal ke taur par kin do bare zehreele materials par baat ki gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plastics aur heavy metals do bari pareshaniyan hain jin par misaal ke taur par baat ki gayi (31.2.2).

book_ref.quote: Plastics and heavy metals are two major concerns

blocks.prompt:
64 Compared with recovering aluminium from its raw ore, recycling aluminium consumes:
(Raw ore se aluminium nikalne ke muqable mein aluminium ki recycling kitni energy leti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aluminium ki recycling raw ore ke muqable mein 95 percent kam energy leti hai (31.2.3).

book_ref.quote: the recycling of aluminium consumes 95 percent less energy

blocks.prompt:
65 If producing 1 kg of aluminium from its raw ore needs 200 MJ (assumed), the energy needed to recycle 15 kg of aluminium (95% less energy) is:
(Agar raw ore se 1 kg aluminium banane mein 200 MJ lagte hain (farz karein), to 15 kg aluminium recycle karne mein (95% kam energy) kitni energy lagegi?)
blocks.explanation: Primary energy = 15 × 200 = 3000 MJ; recycling ko is ka 5% = 0.05 × 3000 = 150 MJ (31.2.3).

book_ref.quote: One of its other advantages is energy saving

blocks.prompt:
66 Which of the following is an advantage of recycling given in the chapter?
(In mein se recycling ka kaun sa faida chapter mein diya gaya hai?)

options.text: Yeh landfills mein kachra barhati hai
Yeh hamesha primary production se zyada energy leti hai
Yeh contaminated plastic ko food-grade bana deti hai
